Moonnam Pakkam
Moonnam Pakkam is a 1988 Indian Malayalam- language sentimental drama film written and directed by Padmarajan. It stars Jayaram, Thilakan, Kirti Singh, Jagathi Sreekumar, Rahman, Ashokan and Ajayan. Kirti and Ajayan made their debut in this film. This film was also a commercial success.
